shared_reference_and_exchange_rules: Resolve job identity, runtime route, incoming endpoint and saved milestone before preparing a phase card.
Bind only 2–4 reviewed images on a later execution card; a source path or Builder reference pool is not an automatic binding.
One proposal carries one action and at most one camera move. Split multi-action phases rather than compressing milestones.
Returned footage remains GENERATED_PENDING_QC. Generator metadata cannot set generation_ready or delivery_accepted.
QC findings bind exact returned artifact hashes and exact [start_frame,end_frame_exclusive) spans; only a reviewed REGENERATE decision may request the next attempt.
A changed job, event, entity, dependency, reference or authority invalidates dependent requests and openings.
No automated loop may exceed three attempts without owner/operator review.
